subject: MMPBSA error: LengthError: length mismatch in energy vectors

messages.author: 홍종희
messages.body:
Hi a;l
I got another error produced in MMPBSA run
Loading and checking parameter files for compatibility...
cpptraj found! Using amber22/bin/cpptraj
mmpbsa_py_energy found! Using amber22/bin/mmpbsa_py_energy
Preparing trajectories for simulation...
20 frames were processed by cpptraj for use in calculation.
Running calculations on normal system...
Beginning GB calculations with /usr/local/amber22/bin/mmpbsa_py_energy
calculating complex contribution...
calculating receptor contribution...
calculating ligand contribution...
File "/usr/local/amber22/bin/MMPBSA.py", line 108, in
app.parse_output_files()
File "/usr/local/amber22/lib/python3.10/site-packages/MMPBSA_mods/main.py", line 995, in parse_output_files
self.calc_types[key]['delta'] = BindClass(
File "/usr/local/amber22/lib/python3.10/site-packages/MMPBSA_mods/amber_outputs.py", line 1027, in __init__
self.delta2()
File "/usr/local/amber22/lib/python3.10/site-packages/MMPBSA_mods/amber_outputs.py", line 1256, in delta2
self.lig.fill_composite_terms()
File "/usr/local/amber22/lib/python3.10/site-packages/MMPBSA_mods/amber_outputs.py", line 373, in fill_composite_terms
self.data[component] = self.data[key] + self.data[component]
File "/usr/local/amber22/lib/python3.10/site-packages/MMPBSA_mods/amber_outputs.py", line 62, in __add__
raise LengthError('length mismatch in energy vectors')
LengthError: length mismatch in energy vectors
how can I trace the problem associated with this error ?
Thanks

messages.author: Jason Swails
messages.body:
Check the ligand output files and see if you can find an error in any
energy calculation for any of the frames.
The problem here is that MMPBSA.py found fewer ligand energy terms than it
found for the bound complex and receptors. The output files should show
errors if they were printed by the program that computed the energy.
Good luck,
Jason
